----------
request : Request
    Body with card_id and optional notes
pk : str
    Primary key of the collection

Returns
-------
Response
    201 with the updated collection

delete.description:
Remove a card from one of my collections.

Parameters
----------
request : Request
    The authenticated request
pk : str
    Primary key of the collection
card_id : str
    Primary key of the card to remove

Returns
-------
Response
    204 when removed; 404 when the card is not in the collection

Serializer for CreditCard list views.

Includes the bank identity and the detail fields the frontend transforms
and renders (reward policy, additional features, waiver policy and fee
strings), while preserving the existing bank_name field.

Writes take ``card_ids`` (ordered, 1 to MAX_CARDS_PER_COMPARISON unique

token so the owner can build a public link.
